fusions.name: Flick From the Rock
fusions.desc: Flicks a point at the first enemy in line, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Shed Spines
fusions.desc: Sheds a ring of spines, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Still as Basking
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 80% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Strike
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
